title: Personal Credit Cards: smallest and largest credit limit by tier
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: credit limit range by tier

This comparison card covers the Personal Credit Cards line and gives, for each card tier, the smallest credit limit the bank assigns on that card and the largest credit limit the card can carry.

## Tier table

| Card tier | Smallest credit limit assigned | Largest credit limit the card can carry |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 300.00 USD | 5000.00 USD |
| College Rewards Visa | 500.00 USD | 3000.00 USD |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | 1000.00 USD | 25000.00 USD |
| Cash Rewards Visa | 1000.00 USD | 25000.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 5000.00 USD | 50000.00 USD |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | 15000.00 USD | 100000.00 USD |

## Reading the range

- The smallest credit limit is the lowest limit ever assigned on the tier.
- The largest credit limit is the ceiling the tier's card can carry; no limit on that tier stands above it.
- Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa share the same range.

## Basis Q&A (hypothetical figures)

**Q: Could a Travel Rewards Visa Signature carry a hypothetical limit of 60000.00 USD?**
A: No. The largest limit that tier can carry is 50000.00 USD.

**Q: Is a hypothetical College Rewards Visa limit of 400.00 USD within the tier's range?**
A: No. The smallest limit assigned on College Rewards Visa is 500.00 USD.

**Q: Which tier has the widest range?**
A: Visa Infinite Private Client, from 15000.00 USD up to 100000.00 USD.
